amendment_ledger.change: the multi-horizon operators are built from the persistence-residualized cross-covariance C_k = E[x_t (y_{t,k} - b_k(x_t))^T], and Q-W whitens by the covariance of that same residualized object; the raw-C_k form is a diagnostic
amendment_ledger.rationale: the score is a gain over persistence, so an objective built on the raw target is rewarded for predicting the present, which dominates lags 1 and 2 and readmits the energy confound the whitened metric was chosen to exclude
amendment_ledger.when: before any R2.4 development number was computed

amendment_ledger.change: each lag's operator term is trace-normalized before summing
amendment_ledger.rationale: equal weights apply to objective terms rather than to scores and cross-covariance magnitude decays with lag, so the unnormalized sum yields a short-lag carrier wearing a multi-horizon label
amendment_ledger.when: before any R2.4 development number was computed

amendment_ledger.change: deletion family F (energy-matched at varying rank) is REQUIRED and is the primary L-axis comparator, with the dose-response curve as continuous context
amendment_ledger.rationale: the impossibility argument forbids matching rank and captured variance at once near the variance-maximizing subspace, not matching variance at higher rank
amendment_ledger.when: before any R2.4 development number was computed

amendment_ledger.change: step C6b replays the frozen deletion family on CONFIRM-Q; until it runs, L1_GEOMETRY_SPECIFIC_DELETION may not be emitted
amendment_ledger.rationale: section 5.4 requires the replay but the section 19 C-sequence has no step for it, and C6 answers a different question
amendment_ledger.when: before any R2.4 development number was computed

amendment_ledger.change: ridge stability is a reported axis: both estimators are refit across the frozen rho grid and the subspace correlation between variants decides R1/R0
amendment_ledger.rationale: a ridge artifact appears identically in both document halves and therefore passes split-half stability, so that machinery structurally cannot detect it
amendment_ledger.when: before any R2.4 development number was computed

amendment_ledger.change: an anisotropic no-prediction world Q-S6 is added to the required worlds
amendment_ledger.rationale: Q-S0 is isotropic and Q-S3 only shows Q-W can find a real low-variance carrier; nothing shows it does not manufacture one from a poorly estimated tail
amendment_ledger.when: before any R2.4 development number was computed

amendment_ledger.change: eta_rank is taken against a multi-horizon SHARED-source ceiling; the per-lag free-source reduced-rank ceiling is kept and labelled as a looser upper bound
amendment_ledger.rationale: the per-lag ceiling is not subject to the shared-subspace constraint every candidate carrier carries, and the penalty grows with the spread of K_Q
amendment_ledger.when: before any R2.4 development number was computed

amendment_ledger.change: sizing is decided by split-half MSC at rank 64, the slowest-converging endpoint, and the reproduction requirement gets a numeric threshold frozen at S6
amendment_ledger.rationale: the stability endpoint gates the label that decides the handoff and converges far more slowly than predictive gain, and 'material magnitude' would otherwise be settled after reading the test
amendment_ledger.when: before any R2.4 development number was computed

amendment_ledger.change: the autonomy stage receiving this carrier either draws a fresh pool or takes composition statistics only from R2.4's untouched test split
amendment_ledger.rationale: composition retention's denominator is the carrier's own predictive gain, so computing it where the carrier was fitted reintroduces the R2.3 denominator problem one stage later
amendment_ledger.when: before any R2.4 development number was computed

amendment_ledger.amends: amendment A3 and source sections 5.3 and 5.4
amendment_ledger.change: the energy-matched deletion family is unattainable in the direction A3 assumed, and is replaced as primary L-axis comparator by a DOSE-MATCHED geometry contrast: at each attainable deleted-variance dose, a top-principal-direction deletion against a lowest-principal-direction deletion of the same dose
amendment_ledger.rationale: the leading 16 directions hold about 0.672 of aperture variance, so every other direction together holds only about 0.328: no set of lower directions can reach the target's dose at any rank.  Matching dose downward instead of upward keeps A3's intent -- hold the energy fixed and vary the geometry -- inside what the spectrum allows, and it yields a curve rather than a single point
amendment_ledger.when: decided from the DEV-Q deletion audit's variance arithmetic, before any confirmatory number existed

amendment_ledger.change: the primary score is the baseline-augmented gain -- the predictor is b_k(x_t) + D_{Q,k} Q^T x_t rather than D_{Q,k} Q^T x_t alone -- and source section 3's literal form is co-reported as gamma_raw
amendment_ledger.rationale: under the literal form a rank-r carrier must also RECONSTRUCT the persistent component from r dimensions, so its gain over persistence is large and negative at every rank below the aperture; every efficiency ratio of source section 7.3 then divides a negative number by a positive one and the compression summary of section 9 is undefined.  The augmented form is also exactly the quantity amendment A1's residualized objective optimizes, so estimator and score agree
amendment_ledger.when: decided from a synthetic implementation smoke world, before any DEV-Q or CONFIRM-Q number was computed

amendment_ledger.change: the P0 identifier collision is resolved: S0..S6 name development steps, C0..C9b name confirmatory steps, D-AUDIT names the variance-deletion audit, and P0_/P1_ remain P-axis result labels
amendment_ledger.rationale: the same class of drift made an earlier specification's execution order disagree with its own section labels and produced a real defect
amendment_ledger.when: before any R2.4 development number was computed

dev_deletion_primary_comparison.note: the largest dose both constructions can reach; positive delta means removing top-variance directions destroys more predictive gain than removing lower directions carrying the same aperture variance

dev_energy_match_attainability.note: amendment A12: the leading directions hold more aperture variance than every other direction combined, so no lower-direction deletion reaches the target's dose at any rank; the comparison is made at attainable doses instead

estimators.forbidden: no composition, semigroup, spectral-simplicity or causal-transport term enters either objective

evidence.rank_rule: the SMALLEST rank reaching the frozen fraction of the nested rank-64 curve on VALIDATION documents, frozen before any test read
evidence.ridge_rule: resolved on fit documents only by document-grouped cross-validation of the whitened score at the reference rank, every candidate scored through one fixed reference metric

decision.endpoint: split-half mean subspace correlation at rank 64 (amendment A8)
decision.extrapolation_note: DEV-Q supports fit halves up to 1000 documents, so the 4000 and 8000 candidates are extrapolations of the fitted 1/m form rather than measurements
decision.rule: the smallest candidate whose predicted split-half MSC at the largest rank is within msc_tolerance of the fitted asymptote AND whose predicted gain bootstrap standard error is at most se_max; otherwise the largest candidate

step_names.C1: fit full and rank-r predictive ceilings on fit documents
step_names.C2: fit Q-E and Q-W rank curves
step_names.C4: validation rank freeze and metric-geometry classification
step_names.C6: Q-W complement refit and deletion controls
step_names.C6b: replay the frozen D-AUDIT deletion family on CONFIRM-Q (amendment A4)
step_names.C7: freeze P/G/I/L labels and all carrier artifacts
step_names.C9: freeze the reference carrier object for the next M stage
step_names.S0: lock the specification and the existing-run provenance
step_names.S1: D-AUDIT, the variance-dose deletion audit on DEV-Q
step_names.S3: implement and unit-test the full and reduced-rank ceilings
step_names.S4: implement and unit-test Q-E and Q-W on the known-answer worlds
step_names.S5: DEV rank curves, stability learning curves, ridge sweep, sizing
step_names.S6: freeze lags, weights, ridges, rank rule, nulls, thresholds, sample size

evidence.test_discipline: the test split is read exactly once, after C7 has frozen every label, rank, carrier identity and threshold; the counter starts at zero here

threshold_basis.compression_fraction: source section 9 fixes it at 0.90; it is a compression summary, not a significance threshold, and the whole rank curve is reported beside it
threshold_basis.deletion_margin_relative: the matched-dose deletion gap must exceed 5 percent of the full-aperture gain AND have a document-bootstrap lower bound above zero; a bare interval above zero is too easy to clear with thousands of documents
threshold_basis.metric_concordance_fraction: the cross-metric overlap is judged against the within-half bootstrap self-overlap rather than a constant, so the threshold asks whether the two metrics agree as well as one metric agrees with itself under resampling, up to a 20 percent shortfall
threshold_basis.positive_gain_floor: inherited: a surviving-fraction ratio is not formed when its denominator is below this gain
threshold_basis.redundancy_relative_high: source section 12.2: a complement refit retaining at least half of the primary carrier's gain is a redundant carrier family, not a shoulder
threshold_basis.redundancy_relative_low: below 20 percent retention the primary carrier is a dominant channel under the tested linear aperture
threshold_basis.reproduction_min_fraction: amendment A8 gives source section 15 point 5 a number: the single test read must reproduce at least 0.75 of the validation value with the same sign, on both the predictive endpoint and the geometry endpoint
threshold_basis.ridge_stability_min: amendment A5: a carrier that keeps 0.80 of its subspace across a decade of whitening ridge is a carrier; one that does not is a regularization choice
threshold_basis.sizing_msc_tolerance: amendment A8: the chosen size must put split-half MSC at the largest rank within 0.05 of the fitted asymptote
threshold_basis.sizing_se_max: the multi-horizon gain's document-bootstrap standard error must be at most 0.010, which is about a tenth of the development pool's rank-16 gain
threshold_basis.stability_alpha: with 400 association-destruction refits the finest attainable empirical p-value is 1/401, and stability requires exceeding every null replicate
